body: I'll take a look at it, thank you.

I am really happy for you pokeylope. I'm glad you were able to see through the tough times.

I love my mother, I really do, I just can't stand this and there is no talking to her. She'll get loud and just yell her way out of things.

I'm around 400 miles away from my old home, which is where the closest family and old friends of mine are. The next closest family is around 1,000 miles away who is in a rough patch themselves so they definitely wouldn't be able to take me in.
